_**User**_

You are performing a security audit of the Dr. Claw project at /Users/domqiu/Works/dr-claw.

Focus ONLY on **Command Injection & Shell Security**. Examine:
1. All uses of child_process (spawn, exec, execFile, execSync, fork) - look for user input being passed to shell commands
2. node-pty usage - terminal spawning with user input
3. Agent CLI invocation (claude, gemini, codex) - argument injection
4. Any eval(), Function(), vm.runInNewContext() usage
5. Template string interpolation in shell commands
6. Environment variable injection
7. Process spawning without proper argument escaping

Key areas:
- server/ (all files, especially routes and any agent integration)
- scripts/
- Any file that imports child_process, node-pty, or similar

Return a detailed list of security findings with:
- Severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
- File path and line numbers
- Description of the vulnerability
- Specific code snippets showing the issue
